corpus.text: Aina AI Refund Policy: Customers can request a full refund within 14 days of purchase if their API usage is under 100 requests. Enterprise contracts have custom refund terms specified in their SLA.

Pricing Plans & Tiers: The Starter plan costs $15 per month and allows up to 3 chatbots, 500 uploaded documents, and 2 team members. The Professional plan costs $49 per month with 10 chatbots and unlimited team members.
WhatsApp Integration: Connect your chatbot to WhatsApp using the Meta Cloud API v21.0. You must provide your WhatsApp Verify Token, Access Token, and Phone Number ID in the Channel Deployments tab.

Document Ingestion & File Formats: Aina AI supports PDF (via PyMuPDF), Word Documents (.docx via python-docx), CSV files, and Website URLs (crawled via Firecrawl). Maximum single file upload size is 50MB.

Vector Database & Embeddings: We use Google Gemini 3072-dimensional embeddings (gemini-embedding-2-preview) stored in PostgreSQL with the pgvector extension. Hybrid search combines dense vector distance with TSVECTOR keyword ranking.
Persona Configuration: Each chatbot can have a custom Persona with name, greeting message, fallback message, and personality traits (e.g., Professional, Empathetic, Concise).
Multi-Tenancy & Security: All documents, vectors, and conversations are isolated by organization ID (org_id) using PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS). No data leaks across tenant organizations.

Human Escalation & Live Handoff: When users express frustration or ask to speak with a human agent, the conversation is marked ESCALATED and routed to the least-busy administrator via Server-Sent Events (SSE).
